projects.body: const s=d.password; const categories=[/[a-z]/,/[A-Z]/,/\d/,/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/].filter(r=>r.test(s)).length; const score=(s.length>=12?2:s.length>=8?1:0)+categories; return {length:s.length,categories,rating:score>=6?'Strong':score>=4?'Moderate':'Weak'};

projects.title: Match Day
projects.description: Calculate pairings for a single round-robin tournament.
projects.body: const teams=lines(d.teams); if(new Set(teams).size!==teams.length) throw Error('Team names must be unique'); const matches=[]; for(let i=0;i<teams.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<teams.length;j++) matches.push(teams[i]+' vs '+teams[j]); return {teams:teams.length,matches:matches.length,schedule:matches.join('; ')||'No matches'};
